definitions.gloss: green car ticket; first-class rail ticket
definitions.explanation: A supplementary ticket required to ride in the Green Car (first-class carriage) on JR trains in Japan, purchased in addition to a regular fare ticket.

examples.japanese: グリーン{券|けん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いたい→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to buy a green car ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グリーン{券|けん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better to reserve a Shinkansen green car ticket in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧グリーン{券|けん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since you need a green car ticket on top of the base fare and limited express surcharge, the cost ends up being quite high.

notes:
Compound of グリーン (green) and ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket). The name comes from JR's Green Car (⟦グリーン{車|しゃ}→グリーン車：08489_guriinsha⟧), the first-class seating section with wider seats and more legroom. The term is specific to the JR rail network.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- グリーン{券|けん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase a green car ticket
- グリーン{券|けん}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: green car ticket counter
- ⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧グリーン{券|けん}: unreserved green car ticket
- ⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧グリーン{券|けん}: reserved green car ticket

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦グリーン{車|しゃ}→グリーン車：08489_guriinsha⟧: Green Car, the first-class carriage itself
- ⟦{乗車券|じょうしゃけん}→乗車券：05298_joushaken⟧: base fare ticket
- ⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧: limited express surcharge ticket
- ⟦{普通車|ふつうしゃ}→普通車：20940_futsuusha⟧: standard-class carriage
